name: Eleven Point River — Thomasville River Access to Myrtle Access
gaugeName: Eleven Point River near Bardley, MO (USGS 07071500)
blurb: The Eleven Point National Scenic River in Mark Twain National Forest from Thomasville toward the Arkansas line, with Forest Service mileages.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Thomasville River Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Cane Bluff River Access: exact agency access pin. Mark Twain NF forest order, Eleven Point Wild and Scenic River zone: motorboats over 25 horsepower prohibited. USFS (Thomasville River Access): "This section of river can usually be floated March through June. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: USFS Mark Twain NF site description.
